outcome: Live birth rate after first embryo transfer (ET)
cohort: 962 patients with prior delivery who underwent their first subsequent embryo transfer (fresh or frozen) between January 2013 and September 2019
finding: Live birth rates following the first embryo transfer were significantly lower in patients with a prior cesarean delivery compared to those with only prior vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: Live birth rates following first ET were significantly lower after cesarean delivery compared to vaginal delivery.
